problem: The canonical predictive-engine run reached production deployment 79 but its error handler threw TypeError because the Supabase query builder was treated as a Promise with .catch(). This masked the original predictive exception and prevented a same-day failure receipt.
root_cause: PostgREST query builders are thenable but do not expose Promise.prototype.catch
the failure-receipt path was not covered by a regression that exercises its exact source contract
decision: Await the receipt write inside a bounded nested try/catch so receipt persistence can never replace the original predictive failure.

prevention.rule: All Supabase query-builder writes in error paths must be awaited; secondary receipt failures preserve the primary exception.
prevention.regression: tests/brain-predictive-production-lineage.test.mjs rejects query-builder .catch chaining and requires an awaited bounded try/catch.

evidence.runtime_error: TypeError: db.from(...).insert(...).catch is not a function

evaluation.red_condition: query-builder .catch chaining exists in the predictive failure-receipt path
evaluation.green_condition: receipt write is awaited in a nested try/catch and the original predictive exception remains authoritative

outcome: Source fix and regression are present; closure remains open until protected merge, deployed Edge-function readback, one safe rerun and refreshed predictive-health evidence.
